<section_guide number="5" title="Edge Cases" references="2,3,4">
<purpose>Propose the boundary, failure, and abuse situations that decide whether the requirements truly hold.</purpose>

<questions>
1. Ask only when several valid outcomes would change a protected decision: which outcome should apply?
</questions>

<workflow>
Read Sections 2-4. For each FR, consider boundary values, invalid input, repeated or simultaneous
requests, permission violations, external-party failure, and abuse, and propose only the
situations that apply.

Define each as `EC-n` at the start of a table row or list item, with the situation, related FR and
BR IDs, Required or Optional, and the expected business outcome as a pass/fail criterion — for
example rejection, preserving the existing state, recovery, or guidance. Derive outcomes from
approved rules and do not invent policy. When no situation applies, record that in one sentence.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm every EC before saving 5.1.</completion>
</section_guide>
